Ye link nahi lagta. Ye https:// se shuru hona chahiye.
Token nahi: bank SMS nahi aayenge
Jud gaya. Bank SMS aapke Paisapeek mein dikhenge.
Server mil gaya. Bank SMS ke liye poora link (token ke saath) copy karo.
Server mil gaya, par token match nahi hota. Aur se link phir copy karo.

Android ne SMS ki ijaazat rok di. Settings kholo, ⋮ → Allow restricted settings dabao, phir SMS allow karo.
